title: S&P 500 valuation forward-return and drawdown test

return_series.name: S&P 500 Total Return (^SP500TR)
return_series.source: Yahoo Finance via vanexymx monthly collector
return_series.method: Monthly dividend-adjusted total-return index levels, month-over-month ratio
return_series.caveat: Third-party collector; upstream market-data redistribution rights have not been independently confirmed.

methodology.percentile: midrank = 100 × (count(past < current) + 0.5 × count(past = current)) / window; complete fixed windows only; current observation included
methodology.windows: PE-TTM/CAPE: 60 and 120 monthly observations. PB: 20 and 40 quarterly observations.
methodology.forward_horizons: 12, 36 and 60 monthly total-return observations, starting in the month after the valuation date.
methodology.max_drawdown: Maximum peak-to-trough drawdown of compounded monthly total-return wealth within each forward window.
methodology.recovery: Months from maximum-drawdown trough until wealth regains the peak immediately preceding that trough; blank if not recovered by the end of the window.
methodology.thresholds: All observations; rolling percentile ≥70%, ≥80%, ≥90%; comparison group <70%.
limitations: Only total-return series is tested; no price-only return series included.
Return data end 2026-07; incomplete forward windows are left blank.
Forward windows overlap; samples are not independent and results are descriptive, not causal.
Five-year horizon sample is limited; 10-year valuation lookback further reduces sample size.
Quarterly PB remains quarterly, never interpolated to monthly.
Upstream redistribution rights for third-party-derived market data have not been independently confirmed.
